text:
Priya Nair: ok team — Snowflake marketplace listing + Databricks partner listing + SI handoff for vector connector. I want a single launch plan we can share with legal & marketing by EOD Thursday.
Alex Chen: timeline? are we still targeting the week of May 4th for the public listing?
Priya Nair: yes, May 4th for public listing. internal dry-run with SI and hardware partner on Apr 25.
Elena Gomez: can we confirm which artifacts need to be in the marketplace package vs the SI bundle? I can start assembling assets.
Tom Schultz: marketplace package = listing metadata, product overview, screenshots, 1-click deploy artifacts (container image + infra template), pricing SKU. SI bundle = installer scripts, network diagrams, runbook, and performance knobs.
Raj Patel: for on-prem/hardware partners we should include the quantized model artifacts and GPU compatibility matrix. hardware team flagged Ampere + H100 testing matrix.
Alex Chen: posting a short checklist:
```
- listing_meta.md (logo, blurb, tags)
- container image (gcr/registry URL)
- terraform/helm templates
- SI_runbook.pdf
- perf_matrix.csv
- legal_terms_draft.docx
```
Priya Nair: perfect. Elena, can you own listing_meta.md + screenshots?
Elena Gomez: yep. I'll get hero screenshot + 2 workflow gifs. ETA Tue.
Tom Schultz: I'll prepare terraform/helm templates and a small test deployment we can hand to SI. ETA Wed.
Raj Patel: I'll own perf_matrix.csv and the GPU compatibility matrix. Will coordinate with eng-runtime to validate H100 tests by Mon.
Alex Chen: marketing needs a 2-paragraph announcement blurb and a customer story hook. I can draft and share for review by Wed afternoon.
Priya Nair: legal: we need to surface data residency notes for the listing and the private deployment offer. @Zoe (marketplace-bot) can you confirm the marketplace legal fields we must fill?
Zoe (marketplace-bot): Marketplace checklist generated: required fields = vendor_name, product_name, support_contact, enterprise_license_url, data_residency_options, privacy_policy_url, pricing_plans. See /marketplace/checklists/1769876543-checklist.md
Elena Gomez: small question — for Databricks, they prefer a listing that references a DBX partner tile and also a separate notebook integration sample. Do we add a notebooks/ directory to the package?
Tom Schultz: yes add notebooks/ with a minimal example showing how to call the connector from a Databricks notebook and a sample spark config.
Priya Nair: SI handoff: we have two partners — AccelSys and InfraWave. AccelSys will run the integration validation, InfraWave will be the first SI to do a customer pilot. Need to schedule a 60-min kickoff.
Alex Chen: I pinged AccelSys PM (jordan@accelsys) — they're available Apr 26 or Apr 29. Which do we prefer?
Raj Patel: Apr 26 is better so we have buffer before Apr 25 internal dry-run? Wait dry-run is Apr 25 — we should do dry-run before SI kickoff. so pick Apr 29 for SI.
Priya Nair: good catch. Dry-run Apr 25, SI kickoff Apr 29. Add a technical Q&A doc for SI to the bundle.
Elena Gomez: tagging assets: what naming convention for container images? suggestions?
Tom Schultz: use rwinference/{product-name}:v{semver} and also include manifest.json with checksums.
Alex Chen: marketing needs partner logos and certification badges for listings. AccelSys logo + InfraWave logo required. Elena can you collect them with brand guidelines?
Elena Gomez: on it — will request vector and SVGs.
Zoe (marketplace-bot): Reminder: marketplace portal has a 72-hour review SLA after submission. Plan submit no later than Apr 30 to hit May 4 public listing.
Priya Nair: action items summary: Elena = listing_meta + screenshots + logos (Tue). Tom = infra templates + notebooks + manifest (Wed). Raj = perf_matrix + H100 validation (Mon). Alex = marketing blurb + partner announcement draft (Wed PM). Priya = legal terms + data residency notes (Thu AM). Zoe = confirm marketplace fields and review SLA.
Alex Chen: can we get one co-authored checklist doc in Google Drive? I'll create and share.
Priya Nair: yes please. Also include a minimal smoke test matrix for SI to run: 1) deploy, 2) ingest sample data, 3) run an end-to-end query, 4) validate latencies. Tom can add commands.
Tom Schultz: sample smoke test snippet I'll add to runbook:
```
# deploy
helm install rwinference ./charts/rwinference --set image.tag=v1.2.0
# ingest
python examples/ingest.py --file sample.json
# query
curl -X POST https://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Raj Patel: also include a perf baseline script and the dataset seed we used during validation. I'll upload perf-baseline.tar.gz.
Elena Gomez: one blocker — need legal to confirm if we can include a 30-day trial license in the listing. Priya can you escalate?
Priya Nair: will escalate to legal. If we can't include trial, marketing will use trial-through-sales wording.
Alex Chen: final question — public announcement: do we want a joint press release with AccelSys? marketing preference?
Elena Gomez: partner prefers a joint post. marketing might prefer staggered. Alex, can you sync with growth on co-marketing terms?
Alex Chen: will do.
Priya Nair: thanks all. I'll compile and push the shared checklist by EOD. If anything slips, flag in this thread. :rocket:
